name: Breakout: who is open
caption: Your D has the puck behind the net with their center coming at him. One of your forwards is covered, two are not. He has to move it now.

questions.prompt: Your D is about to pass. Tap the teammate who is open.

fb.right: Yes, your C is the free man. Their forechecker took away your wall, so the puck has to go the other way.
fb.partial: Also open, but your C is the better outlet: that pass is shorter and away from the pressure.
fb.wrong: your RW is covered: look at the opponent standing right on him. The pass has to go to someone with ice around him.

questions.prompt: Your D is about to pass. Tap the teammate who is open.

fb.right: Yes, your RW is the free man. That is you: stopped on the wall, forehand ready.
fb.partial: Also open, but your RW is the better outlet: the wall is the safe side and the puck comes to your forehand.
fb.wrong: your C is covered: look at the opponent standing right on him. The pass has to go to someone with ice around him.
